verdict.rationale: Notte's docs say it can persist cookies and login state across sessions, and its site advertises 'Authenticated Profiles', meaning browser profiles for each agent. Together these cover reusable profiles that let later runs skip the login wall. Both are only one-line marketing or overview claims. missing for 10: in-depth docs on creating and reusing profiles (API/SDK usage, lifecycle, expiry handling), independent or hands-on corroboration that saved sessions skip logins reliably.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist logged-in browser state in reusable profiles so agents skip the login wall on every subsequent run

citations.quote: Persist cookies and login state across sessions.
Authenticated Profiles Browser profiles for each agent
